dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Tadi malam aku menonton film baru yang dibicarakan semua orang. Kamu sudah menontonnya?
dialogue.en: I saw that new movie everyone is talking about last night. Have you seen it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Belum. Aku membaca ulasan yang bilang alur ceritanya agak mudah ditebak.
dialogue.en: Not yet. I read a review that said the plot was a bit predictable.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Jujur saja, paruh pertamanya begitu, tetapi akhirnya benar-benar mengejutkanku.
dialogue.en: Honestly, the first half is, but the ending completely surprised me.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Menarik. Bagaimana menurutmu akting pemeran utamanya?
dialogue.en: Interesting. What did you think of the lead performance?

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Luar biasa. Aktrisnya membuat tokohnya terasa nyata dan kompleks.
dialogue.en: Outstanding. The actress made her character feel real and complex.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Dan sutradaranya? Aku menyukai karya-karyanya sebelumnya.
dialogue.en: And the director? I loved his previous work.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Dia mempertahankan gayanya yang biasa, dengan pengambilan gambar panjang dan sedikit dialog.
dialogue.en: He keeps his usual style, with long shots and very little dialogue.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Itu bisa indah, atau membosankan, tergantung ceritanya.
dialogue.en: That can be beautiful, or boring, depending on the story.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Di sini berhasil, terutama karena musik latarnya. Musiknya menambah banyak emosi.
dialogue.en: Here it works, especially because of the soundtrack. It adds so much emotion.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Menurutmu, apakah film itu layak ditonton di bioskop?
dialogue.en: Would you say the movie is worth watching in the movie theater?

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Pasti. Gambar dan suaranya butuh layar besar.
dialogue.en: Definitely. The images and the sound need a big screen.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Kalau begitu aku akan pergi akhir pekan ini, meskipun para kritikus tidak sepakat.
dialogue.en: Then I will go this weekend, even though critics disagree.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Kritikus dan penonton jarang sependapat, jadi tentukan sendiri pendapatmu.
dialogue.en: Critics and audiences rarely agree, so make up your own mind.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Benar. Mana yang akan kamu beri nilai lebih tinggi, film ini atau film terakhirnya?
dialogue.en: True. Which would you rate higher, this movie or his last one?

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Film terakhirnya, tetapi hanya sedikit. Film ini kuberi empat bintang dari lima.
dialogue.en: His last one, but only slightly. I would give this one four stars out of five.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Baik untuk diketahui. Mari kita bahas lagi setelah aku menontonnya.
dialogue.en: Good to know. Let us discuss it again after I have seen it.
